plugins.name: AI 翻译
plugins.description: 选中文字后一键 AI 翻译，支持自动识别源语言和多目标语言切换
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Frequent context switching to translation tools disrupts workflow. This plugin embeds AI translation into the desktop—select text, get instant results.
purpose.zh: 在阅读外文资料、编写国际化代码或与海外同事沟通时，频繁切换翻译工具打断工作流。AI 翻译插件将翻译能力嵌入桌面，选中即译，让语言不再成为障碍。

en: Reading foreign docs: translate selected paragraphs instantly
Code comments: quickly understand foreign annotations
Cross-language communication: translate emails and messages
Language learning: translate vocabulary and example sentences
zh: 阅读外文文档：选中段落一键翻译，无需复制粘贴
代码注释翻译：快速理解外文注释和文档
跨语言沟通：翻译邮件、聊天消息后发送
学习辅助：翻译生词和例句，辅助语言学习

longDescription.en: AI Translator leverages advanced AI models to support one-click translation of selected text, with automatic source language detection and multi-target language switching.
longDescription.zh: AI 翻译插件利用先进的 AI 模型，支持选中文字后一键翻译，自动识别源语言并切换多目标语言，让跨语言沟通无障碍。

en: Automatic source language detection, no manual selection needed
Multi-target language switching (English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, etc.)
Quick Action panel integration—select text to translate
Standalone popup mode, translation results don't obscure original text
zh: 自动识别源语言，无需手动选择
多目标语言切换（英、日、韩、法、德等）
快捷操作面板集成，选中文本即可翻译
独立弹窗模式，翻译结果不遮挡原文

plugins.name: JSON 格式化
plugins.description: JSON 解析、格式化、压缩、JS 处理与多维可视化
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Developers frequently handle complex JSON data when debugging APIs, editing configs, or exchanging data. This plugin integrates formatting, compression, querying, and visualization into one tool.
purpose.zh: 开发者在调试 API、配置文件、数据交换时经常需要处理复杂的 JSON 数据。JSON 格式化插件将格式化、压缩、查询、可视化整合到一个工具中，替代多个在线工具。

en: API debugging: format compressed JSON responses
Config editing: beautify and validate JSON config files
Data analysis: browse large JSON datasets in table view
Data transformation: filter and map JSON with JS processing engine
zh: API 调试：格式化 API 返回的压缩 JSON 响应
配置编辑：美化和验证 JSON 配置文件
数据分析：表格视图浏览大型 JSON 数据集
数据转换：用 JS 处理引擎对 JSON 进行筛选和映射

longDescription.en: JSON Format provides parsing, beautification, compression, JS processing, and multi-dimensional visualization—the Swiss Army knife for developers working with JSON data.
longDescription.zh: JSON 格式化插件提供解析、美化、压缩、JS 处理与多维可视化，是开发者处理 JSON 数据的瑞士军刀。

en: JSON beautify (2/4 space indent) and single-line minify
JS processing engine: custom function body to process JSON data
Multi-dimensional visualization: table, image, tree, text views
Web Worker async processing, zero UI blocking
zh: JSON 美化（2/4 空格缩进）与单行压缩
JS 处理引擎：自定义 JS 函数体处理 JSON 数据
多维可视化：表格、图片、树形、文本视图
Web Worker 异步处理，UI 零阻塞

plugins.name: JSON 转 Excel
plugins.description: 将 JSON 数据一键转换为 Excel 表格，支持嵌套展开、多 Sheet、数据预览
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Manually converting JSON data into Excel spreadsheets is tedious, and online converters pose data privacy risks. This plugin provides a local, offline JSON-to-Excel converter with nested object flattening and multi-sheet support.
purpose.zh: 手动将 JSON 数据转换为 Excel 表格既繁琐又耗时，在线转换工具还存在数据隐私风险。本插件提供本地离线的 JSON 转 Excel 工具，支持嵌套对象自动展开和多 Sheet 导出。

en: API data export: convert API response JSON into Excel for analysis
Data reporting: transform nested JSON structures into flat spreadsheets
Batch data processing: export multiple arrays into separate sheets
Offline conversion: convert sensitive JSON data locally without upload
zh: API 数据导出：将接口返回的 JSON 转换为 Excel 进行分析
数据报表：将嵌套 JSON 结构转换为扁平表格
批量数据处理：将多个数组分别导出到不同工作表
离线转换：敏感 JSON 数据本地转换，无需上传云端

longDescription.en: JSON to Excel is a professional local conversion tool that turns JSON data into Excel spreadsheets with nested object flattening (dot notation), multi-sheet support, data preview, and configurable export options.
longDescription.zh: JSON 转 Excel 是一款专业的本地转换工具，将 JSON 数据转换为 Excel 表格，支持嵌套对象自动展开（dot notation）、多 Sheet 导出、数据预览和可配置导出选项。

en: One-click JSON to Excel conversion
Nested object auto-flattening with dot notation
Multi-sheet export for multiple arrays
Table-based data preview before conversion
Configurable export: header style, empty value handling, auto column width
QuickAction integration: auto-detects JSON text in context panel
zh: 一键 JSON 转 Excel 转换
嵌套对象 dot notation 自动展开
多数组自动分 Sheet 导出
转换前表格化数据预览
可配置导出：表头样式、空值处理、自动列宽
QuickAction 集成：快捷操作面板自动识别 JSON 文本

plugins.name: 密码管理器
plugins.description: 本地零知识加密密码保险库：主密码 + Windows Hello 解锁、密码生成器、安全体检、Popup 快速取密
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Reusing a few passwords across dozens of sites is the norm, and cloud password managers raise privacy concerns. This plugin provides a local zero-knowledge vault with fast Windows Hello unlock, instant search-copy, and a password health dashboard.
purpose.zh: 在几十个网站之间复用少量密码是常态，而云端密码管理器又带来隐私顾虑。本插件提供本地零知识加密密码保险库，支持 Windows Hello 快速解锁、即搜即复制和密码健康体检。

en: Quick retrieval: popup window, type a keyword, Enter to copy, clipboard auto-clears in 30s
Signup: generate a strong random password or passphrase on the spot
Health checkup: find weak, reused, and stale passwords via the dashboard
Safe backup: export an encrypted .mdvault file to a USB drive, restore on a new machine
zh: 快速取密：Popup 弹窗输入关键词回车即复制，剪贴板 30 秒自动清除
注册新账号：现场生成高强度随机密码或口令短语
安全体检：通过仪表盘找出弱密码、复用密码和过期密码
安全备份：导出加密 .mdvault 文件到 U 盘，新机器一键恢复

longDescription.en: Password Manager is a local zero-knowledge encrypted vault: master password + Windows Hello unlock, built-in password generator, security health checkup, and Popup quick retrieval. Data never leaves your device.
longDescription.zh: 密码管理器是本地零知识加密密码保险库：主密码 + Windows Hello 解锁、内置密码生成器、安全体检、Popup 快速取密。数据永不出设备。

en: Zero-knowledge local encryption, data never uploaded
Windows Hello (PIN / biometric) unlock support
Strong password & passphrase generator
Password health dashboard: weak / reused / stale detection
Popup quick retrieval with auto-clearing clipboard
Encrypted .mdvault backup & restore
Recovery key for forgotten master password
zh: 零知识本地加密，数据永不上传
Windows Hello（PIN/生物识别）解锁支持
高强度密码与口令短语生成器
密码健康体检：弱密码/复用/过期检测
Popup 快速取密，剪贴板自动清除
加密 .mdvault 备份与恢复
恢复密钥：忘记主密码时可找回

plugins.name: 番茄钟
plugins.description: 25+5 专注模式，自动短休息/长休息切换，统计记录
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Modern life is full of distractions. This plugin applies the classic Pomodoro Technique (25min focus + 5min break) to help overcome procrastination and build healthy deep work habits.
purpose.zh: 现代生活中干扰无处不在，社交媒体、邮件、消息通知不断打断专注。番茄钟 Pro 基于经典的番茄工作法（25 分钟专注 + 5 分钟休息），帮助你克服拖延症，建立健康的深度工作习惯。

en: Study and exam prep: sustained focus for long study sessions
Remote work: manage work rhythm and avoid prolonged sitting
Project management: break complex tasks into manageable pomodoros
Habit building: maintain daily pomodoro count for consistent rhythm
zh: 学习备考：考研、考证、语言学习等需要长时间专注的场景
远程办公：居家办公时自我管理工作节奏，避免久坐
项目管理：将复杂任务拆解为多个番茄钟，逐步推进
习惯养成：每日固定番茄钟数量，培养稳定的工作节律

longDescription.en: Pomodoro Pro is a focus efficiency tool based on the scientific Pomodoro Technique. Through 25-minute focus + 5-minute break cycles, it helps you overcome procrastination and boost productivity.
longDescription.zh: 番茄钟 Pro 是一款基于科学番茄工作法的专注效率工具。通过 25 分钟专注 + 5 分钟休息的循环，帮助你克服拖延症，提升工作效率。

en: Customizable focus/break durations (5/15/25/45/60 min)
Multiple white noise backgrounds (rain, cafe, fireplace, keyboard)
Task management integration with pomodoro timer binding
Daily/weekly focus statistics with visual charts
Desktop floating window and standalone window dual mode
Focus achievement system and level unlocking
Local encrypted data storage, privacy secured
zh: 自定义专注时长和休息时长（5/15/25/45/60 分钟）
多种白噪音背景音（雨声、咖啡馆、壁炉、键盘声）
任务管理集成，支持番茄计时绑定任务
每日/每周专注数据统计和可视化图表
桌面悬浮窗和独立窗口双模式
专注成就系统和等级解锁
数据本地加密存储，隐私安全

plugins.name: 代理管理
plugins.description: TUN 模式系统级流量路由引擎，虚拟网卡全局流量劫持 + 规则智能路由 + 多代理组管理
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: Manually switching proxy nodes in multi-proxy environments is tedious and error-prone. This plugin integrates node management, rule engine, and auto-switching strategies into one tool.
purpose.zh: 在多代理环境下手动切换代理节点既繁琐又容易出错。代理切换插件将节点管理、规则引擎、自动切换策略整合到一个工具中，让网络代理管理变得简单高效。

en: Dev debugging: frequently switch regional proxies for API testing
Network optimization: multi-node management and latency testing
Enterprise network: hybrid config for intranet direct + external proxy
Gaming: route specific game domains to low-latency nodes
zh: 开发调试：需要频繁切换不同地区代理测试 API 可用性
科学上网：多节点管理与延迟测试，选择最优线路
企业网络：内网直连 + 外网代理的混合策略配置
游戏加速：针对特定游戏域名路由到低延迟节点

longDescription.en: Proxy Switch is a professional network proxy management tool that helps you easily manage multiple proxy nodes with a rule engine for automated proxy switching.
longDescription.zh: 代理切换是一款专业的网络代理管理工具，帮助你轻松管理多个代理节点，配合规则引擎实现自动化代理切换。

en: Multi-node management (HTTP/SOCKS5)
Rule engine: domain suffix, keyword, regex, IP-CIDR
Auto-switching strategies
Bypass list (localhost/LAN auto direct)
Real-time request log viewing
Latency testing
zh: 多节点管理（HTTP/SOCKS5）
规则引擎：域名后缀、关键词、正则、IP-CIDR
自动切换策略
绕过列表（localhost/局域网自动直连）
请求日志实时查看
延迟测试

plugins.name: 系统信息
plugins.description: 一键获取电脑系统、硬件、网络全量信息，支持实时监控与报告导出
plugins.author: My Desktop Tools

purpose.en: When troubleshooting hardware, upgrading configs, or diagnosing networks, users need a quick system overview. This plugin consolidates scattered system tools into a unified interface.
purpose.zh: 在排查硬件问题、升级配置、网络诊断时，用户需要快速获取系统全貌。系统信息插件将分散在各处的系统工具整合为统一界面，一站式查看所有关键信息。

en: Hardware checkup: confirm current specs before purchasing upgrades
Network diagnostics: check IP config, WiFi signal, connectivity
Performance analysis: monitor CPU/memory/disk usage
Peripheral inspection: verify USB devices and listening ports
zh: 硬件排查：购买新硬件前确认当前配置和接口
网络诊断：检查 IP 配置、WiFi 信号、连通性
性能分析：查看 CPU/内存/磁盘使用率
外设检查：确认 USB 设备和监听端口状态

longDescription.en: System Info provides one-click access to comprehensive system, hardware, and network information, with real-time monitoring and report export.
longDescription.zh: 系统信息插件一键获取电脑系统、硬件、网络全量信息，支持实时监控与报告导出，是了解电脑状态的必备工具。

en: System info: OS version, hostname, uptime, timezone
Hardware info: CPU, memory, disk, GPU, motherboard/BIOS
Network info: IP/MAC/gateway/DNS/WiFi details
Peripherals & ports: USB/Bluetooth/monitors/printers/listening ports
zh: 系统信息：OS 版本、主机名、运行时长、时区
硬件信息：CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU、主板/BIOS
网络信息：IP/MAC/网关/DNS/WiFi 详情
外设与端口：USB/蓝牙/显示器/打印机/监听端口
